stations.title: Bridget
stations.say: Thank the ones who stay with us.
stations.note: A box on the house now and then.

stations.title: Today's code
stations.text: Knows the price list, and nothing more.

stations.title: Test, then code
stations.gap: No rule, and no test for it

stations.title: Subscriber
stations.say: This one is on the house?

captions: Bridget wants to give the farm's loyal subscribers a free box now and then.
The price code knows the price list and nothing else, so every box costs the same.
You write a test for the rule first, watch it fail, then write the code that passes it.
Now the loyal box goes out free, and a large one costs no more than it should.
Same price list, a new rule, and a test that proved it could fail before it passed.
